origin.name: Jaipur Junction
origin.formattedAddress: Jaipur Railway Station, Gopalbari, Jaipur, Rajasthan

options.label: Local guide
options.summaryOneLiner: The authentic Pink City transit route: AC City Bus to Badi Chaupar, then local e-rickshaw to Amer fort gates.

steps.title: Walk to Station Outer Bus Stop
steps.instruction: Exit Jaipur Junction via Platform 1 main gate and cross towards the Hasanpura bus shelter.
steps.boardingPoint: Platform 1 Exit, 100m straight past prepaid kiosk
warnings: Ignore touts claiming all buses are discontinued
tips: Keep your luggage close while crossing the station concourse

steps.title: JCTSL AC Bus #AC-1 to Badi Chaupar
steps.instruction: Board City Bus AC-1 or Bus #2 directly to Badi Chaupar (Hawa Mahal circle).
tips: Exact cash or Chalo Card accepted; ask conductor for Badi Chaupar ticket

steps.title: Shared Electric Rickshaw to Amer Fort Town
steps.instruction: Transfer into a shared e-rickshaw or Bus #29 towards Amer Fort lower parking.
steps.boardingPoint: Opposite Hawa Mahal corner, shared stand
warnings: Drivers will suggest stopping at private textile emporiums; politely decline
tips: State Amer Fort Stand clearly before boarding

steps.title: Walk up Suraj Pol Entrance Ramp
steps.instruction: Walk up the scenic stone ramp through Sun Gate (Suraj Pol) into Jaleb Chowk.
steps.boardingPoint: Stone pathway starting past Maota Lake
warnings: Decline unauthorized tour guides without state tourism photo badges
tips: Carry drinking water; steep stone incline

options.label: Fastest
options.summaryOneLiner: Direct auto-rickshaw via Jal Mahal bypass. Fast but requires firm price negotiation.

steps.title: Direct Auto from Jaipur Junction to Amer Fort
steps.instruction: Hire an auto directly to Amer Fort ticket counter via Amer Road.
steps.boardingPoint: Official Prepaid Auto Booth, Platform 1 Exit
warnings: Drivers routinely quote ₹400-₹500 to arriving tourists
Watch for gem jewelry detour offers near Jal Mahal
tips: Offer ₹200-₹220 fixed or demand government digital meter

checklist.title: Carry ₹100 in Cash or UPI
checklist.subtitle: Conductors and small shared autos prefer small bills or UPI QR.

checklist.title: Official Rajasthan Tourism ID Badge
checklist.subtitle: Only hire guides wearing the blue Rajasthan Tourism badge.

checklist.title: Emergency Helpline 112
checklist.subtitle: Jaipur Tourist Police kiosk is located right outside Jaleb Chowk.

origin.name: Delhi Airport (IGI T3)
origin.formattedAddress: Indira Gandhi International Airport Terminal 3, New Delhi

destination.name: Connaught Place
destination.formattedAddress: Rajiv Chowk, Connaught Place, New Delhi, Delhi 110001

options.label: Local guide
options.summaryOneLiner: Airport Express Metro is 3x faster than road traffic and costs ₹60 vs ₹600 taxi.

steps.title: Walk to Airport Metro Station
steps.instruction: Follow orange floor markings in Terminal 3 arrivals hall to the underground metro entrance.
warnings: Taxi touts inside arrivals will claim metro is closed; ignore them
tips: Buy a token or tap any contactless National Common Mobility Card / Paytm

steps.title: Airport Express (Orange Line) to Shivaji Stadium
steps.instruction: Board Airport Express towards New Delhi. Alight at Shivaji Stadium (Connaught Place).
tips: Trains run every 10-15 minutes with air conditioning and luggage racks

steps.title: Walk to Connaught Place Inner Circle
steps.instruction: Exit Shivaji Stadium Gate 1 and walk 400m to Connaught Place Block B / Rajiv Chowk.
warnings: Avoid touts offering 'Tourist Information Office' visits
tips: Pedestrian walkways are wide and well lit

checklist.title: Metro Ticket or Contactless Card
checklist.subtitle: Fare is ₹60 per person directly at ticket gates.

checklist.title: Emergency Helpline 112
checklist.subtitle: Delhi Metro security police DMRP helpline is 1511.

origin.name: Agra Cantt Railway Station
origin.formattedAddress: Agra Cantt, Idgah Colony, Agra, Uttar Pradesh 282001

destination.name: Taj Mahal (East Gate)
destination.formattedAddress: Dharmapuri, Forest Colony, Tajganj, Agra, Uttar Pradesh 282001

options.label: Local guide
options.summaryOneLiner: Official prepaid auto to Shilpgram parking, followed by eco-friendly golf cart to East Gate.

steps.title: Walk to Agra Cantt Prepaid Auto Booth
steps.instruction: Exit Agra Cantt via Gate 1 and walk 50m to the UP Police Prepaid Auto Booth.
warnings: Dozens of aggressive unofficial touts gather outside the train exit; keep walking to booth
tips: Pay the booth clerk directly and keep the customer slip until arrival

steps.title: Prepaid Auto to Shilpgram Eco Parking
steps.instruction: Take prepaid auto to Shilpgram East Gate parking (combustion vehicles are prohibited past this point).
warnings: Drivers will claim the East Gate is closed and offer marble souvenir shops
tips: Give the yellow copy to driver ONLY when you reach Shilpgram

steps.title: Battery Golf Cart to Taj East Gate
steps.instruction: Board the official ASI green battery golf cart from Shilpgram terminal to East Gate.
warnings: Touts selling unauthorized priority tickets operate here
tips: ASI ticket holders ride free; non-ticket holders pay ₹10

checklist.title: ASI Online Ticket QR
checklist.subtitle: Taj Mahal ticket counters on site are paperless. Prebook on asi.payumoney.com

checklist.title: Keep Prepaid Auto Slip Safe
checklist.subtitle: Do not surrender the slip until you are physically at Shilpgram.
